import type { Clock } from '@tsir/core';

/** Everything `{{base}}Service` needs. It is passed in; nothing is looked up. */
export interface {{base}}ServiceDeps {
  readonly clock: Clock;
}

/** Generated by `tsir make:service`. Constructor injection only. */
export class {{base}}Service {
  readonly #clock: Clock;

  constructor(deps: {{base}}ServiceDeps) {
    this.#clock = deps.clock;
  }

  /** Replace with the operations this service owns ({{stem}}). */
  now(): Date {
    return this.#clock.now();
  }
}
